narrations.en: Step 23 (Final Step): The visual proof is complete! Starting from the starting conditions of the 'Definition of a Geometric Sequence', where the basic definitions of expressions and operations and the properties of equations are given as starting conditions, the given expressions are rewritten as basic definitions (division theorem f(x) = (x-a)Q(x) + R, basic row operations, definitions of divisors and multiples, etc.), and the idea of tying them into a common structure is followed by an algebraic system in which the core theorems and solutions of 'Definition of Geometric Sequences' are strictly established from the definitions and basic operation laws. It was clearly confirmed that the conclusion holds. The key point to remember here is that when dividing both sides by an unknown number or the letter a, you must divide into cases where the dividing value a is not 0 (a is not equal to 0) and cases where it is 0 (a = 0) so as not to miss the solution! Finally, ask a deeper question. If we extend this principle of algebraic elimination and equivalent transformation to the matrix Gauss-Jordan elimination method of high school and college linear algebra, how can we solve hundreds of simultaneous equations with an algorithm? Se confirmó claramente que la conclusión es válida. El punto clave a recordar aquí es que al dividir ambos lados por un número desconocido o la letra a, debes dividir en casos donde el valor de división a no es 0 (a no es igual a 0) y casos donde es 0 (a = 0) para no perder la solución. Der wichtigste Punkt, den Sie hier beachten sollten, ist, dass Sie bei der Division beider Seiten durch eine unbekannte Zahl oder den Buchstaben a in Fälle aufteilen müssen, in denen der Teilwert a nicht 0 ist (a ist ungleich 0), und in Fälle, in denen er 0 ist (a = 0), um die Lösung nicht zu verpassen! Cuối cùng, hãy hỏi một câu hỏi sâu sắc hơn.
